subject: general
question: Hurka Baul dance is mainly a narrative dance form performed during the harvesting of maize and paddy crops. It belongs to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttrakhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hurka Baul:**

 
 
• The "**Hurka," or drum**, which is used to accompany the **"Baul," or singing**, is where the word "Hurka Baul" originates.
 
• In the **Kumaon region of Uttrakhand**, it is carried out when growing maize and paddy. 
 
• Dance is mainly a narrative dance form performed during harvesting.
 
• Hurka Baul dance is an integral part of the cultural heritage of Uttarakhand and is performed during various festivals and celebrations in the state.
 
 
 
• **Other prominent dances of Uttrakhand are**:
 
 
• Chaunfla
 
• Chholiya
 
• Jhumeila
 
• Jhora
 
• Pandav Nritya
